title: Artaxerxes’ decree
summary: Jones dates Artaxerxes’ decree in that king’s twentieth year (Neh 2:1).
description: Jones dates Artaxerxes’ decree in that king’s twentieth year (Neh 2:1). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 454 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: The row does not identify this Artaxerxes with Artaxerxes Longimanus or Artaxerxes Mnemon. Neither person was linked.
